verdict.rationale: The docs show several live-observation surfaces. The interactive CLI gives instant feedback and can pause the running agent with Esc. Agent Canvas is described as a control center for agent conversations, and the Agent Server exposes a WebSocket API. The goals guide says a UI can show progress with stop/resume controls, and critic scores are computed during execution. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a live status indicator or event stream showing the agent's current state, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the real-time monitoring experience.
